note: Voiceover for film C. `at` is seconds into the section and `dur` the expected spoken length (scripts/audio/vo.py reports the real one). `role` picks the voice from `cast` (default narrator); fx 'phone' makes a line sound like a call. Narrator: warm, unhurried Indian English.

youtube.text: Every family building a home has heard this.
Building a home in India runs on WhatsApp. Calls. Voice notes. Promises.
And most of it gets lost.
Neev keeps every one of them, as one honest record of your home.
On site, the team just speaks, in Hindi or English. Neev writes it down, with proof.
The builder sees what doesn't add up, before anyone pays.
And the family, wherever they are, finally gets calm.
One look says where the build stands.
Every photo from site, dated and in its place.
Every week, a short letter on how it's going. They can even listen to it.
Ask anything. Neev answers from the record, and never guesses about money or safety.
The choices that are truly theirs come with everything they need to decide.
And everyone they love sees the same truth, in their own language.
Same words. This time, with proof.
Neev. One honest record of your home.
